title: Provider switch state types
responsibility: Defines pending provider switches, session observations and control interfaces, and derives a request revision marker.

inputs.name: switchRevision.record
inputs.description: Switch request whose id and status identify the revision, or null when no request exists.

outputs.name: desktopControlUnavailable
outputs.description: User-facing notice that desktop control is unavailable, requests remain pending and provider settings have not changed.

outputs.name: switchRevision
outputs.description: Request id followed by a colon and its current status, or null for no request.
